newsitem.title: USA: Zions Bancorp buys 32 bank branches.
newsitem.headline: Zions Bancorp buys 32 bank branches.

text.p: Zions Bancorporation said Friday it has a definitive agreement to purchase 32 of Wells Fargo Bank's branches in Arizona, Idaho, Nevada and Utah.
Wells Fargo Bank is a unit of Wells Fargo and Co.

Zions said it will pay Wells Fargo 6.17 percent of the deposits plus the book value of the branch real estate and other fixed assets. As of January 31, the branch deposits were worth about $550 million.
The sale does not include loans, except those that are deposit secured, the company said.
The deal is expected to close in July.
